steps.en: Job picks outstanding notices that already got the 3rd letter
steps.id: Job memilih notice yang sudah menerima surat ke-3

steps.en: Mobile number from the government data source is used
steps.id: Nomor mobile dari sumber data pemerintah dipakai
steps.why_en: The live data lookup is switched off in every environment, so the number stored earlier is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian data langsung dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor yang tersimpan sebelumnya yang dipakai.

steps.en: One SMS per unique owner, opted-out owners skipped
steps.id: Satu SMS per pemilik unik, yang opt-out dilewati

steps.en: SMS text lists the unpaid notices and mentions the 3rd letter
steps.id: Isi SMS memuat notice belum bayar dan menyebut surat ke-3
steps.why_en: The message wording lives only in the database, so it cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan hanya ada di database, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: Batch of SMS is sent to the driver
steps.why_en: Both the scheduler and the SMS switch are off in the repo settings, so nothing goes out until they are turned on.
steps.why_id: Scheduler dan saklar SMS sama-sama mati di setting repo, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim sampai dinyalakan.

steps.en: Each sent SMS is logged so it is not sent twice
steps.id: Setiap SMS terkirim dicatat agar tidak terkirim dua kali
